meta_description: Admissions are open for MEC and CEC at CPE Junior College, Visakhapatnam. Talk to our admissions team or submit an enquiry.
title: Admissions are open for MEC and CEC
intro: Speak to our admissions team, visit the campus in Ram Nagar, and secure a seat for the coming academic year.

process.title: How to apply
steps: Enquire online or visit the campus.
Meet our admissions counsellor for stream guidance.
Submit the application form with required documents.
Complete verification and pay the admission fee.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
items: Candidates must have passed Class 10 (SSC) or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. Stream allotment is based on the student's interest and counselling with our academic team.

documents.title: Documents Required
items: SSC / Class 10 marks memo (original and copies)
Aadhaar copy of student and parent

important_dates.title: Important Dates
items: Admissions open: Announced each academic year
Counselling sessions: On all working days
Classes commence: As per Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh calendar

prospectus.title: Prospectus
prospectus.description: The prospectus can be collected at the college office, or request a copy through the enquiry form.

enquiry.title: Submit an admission enquiry
enquiry.description: Our team will call you back to discuss streams, timings and fees.
enquiry.form_description: Share a few details and our admissions team will get in touch.
